verdicts.why: In Venom the only Kasady scene is the prison interview, where he talks to Eddie and promises carnage. Venom has no exchange with him, and Kasady is not yet Carnage, so a silent presence through Eddie is no stage.
In Peter's To-Do List Flash throws the paper wad at Peter while Ned walks beside him. Nothing passes between Flash and Ned (the plot centres on Peter's errands), so this is no Ned|Flash stage.

Plot: Strange rescues Chavez from a demon with Wong's help, Wanda attacks Kamar-Taj and captures Wong after Strange refuses to give Chavez up, and at the end Strange saves Chavez from Wanda with Wong's help. Text, card lines and kind friend all hold, and nothing comes from a later title.
